post.description: Hooks and control items of the post phase, run in order.

background.description: Start without waiting; join with a later wait/wait-all item, a parallel block's end, or the end of the phase.

captureOutput.description: Post hooks only: include gh stdout/stderr (base64, bounded) in the hook input.

command.description: Executable and arguments; relative paths resolve against the config file directory.

continueOnError.description: Pre hooks only: make a resulting deny non-blocking while preserving the hook's diagnostic result.

dependsOn.description: IDs of hooks (same phase) that must finish first.

command.description: gh command path prefixes such as "pr merge" or "api".

env.description: Invocation environment: names must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; all entries must match. Values use path.Match globs; * means set and non-empty (including /); an empty value means unset or empty. Caller-controlled guardrail, not a security boundary.

exitCode.description: Post hooks only: gh exit codes (0-255) to run for.

level.description: L1 native gh command, L2 gh api REST call, L3 gh api graphql call.

operation.description: Action globs such as pr.merge.* (see docs/normalization.md).

result.description: Post hooks only: success = gh exited 0; failure = non-zero exit, killed by a signal, or gh could not be started.

token.description: Kind of token in GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN: app (ghs_, GitHub App installation, e.g. gain or Actions), user (ghp_/gho_/ghu_/github_pat_), unknown (other value), none (not set: gh's stored login).

optional.description: Skip instead of failing when the command is missing or not executable.

redactInput.description: Redact credentials in this hook's input; enable for hooks that forward input elsewhere. Default false: hooks receive raw input.

oneOf.description: Run these hooks concurrently as background hooks, then wait for all of them (GitHub Actions steps parallel).

mode.description: observe: classify and log only; enforce: deny according to rules, unknown handling and pre-hooks.

onUnresolved.description: deny (default): conservatively apply this rule when repository/host criteria are unresolved; ignore: skip that maybe-match.

unknownInput.description: Handling of input-unavailable/input-too-large operations, including stdin analysis timeouts; default audit.

unknownMutation.description: Handling of readable write/unknown operations that could not be classified; unreadable input uses unknownInput.

hookConcurrency.description: Maximum hooks running at once within a parallel group; default 4.

realGh.description: Absolute path of the real gh; discovered on PATH when empty.

resolveAPI.description: auto (default): read-only API resolution only for actionable repository/host matches; never: disable implicit wrapper API lookups. Explicit management --allow-api still applies.

trust.description: Project-only files added to the hook trust manifest.

skip.description: User config only: repository paths whose project hooks and transforms run without trust. A pattern ending in / matches that directory and everything below it; otherwise the path must match exactly. ~ expands to HOME. A repository matches when its checkout or its main worktree (for linked git worktrees) matches.
